import sys, base64, json, time, resource, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import zstandard as zstd
HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload')
field='a'*131072
line = ','.join(['app','x','0','5','put','L','1','','2001:db8:1:100::1','','open','S','0',field])
rows=1100
blob=(HEADER+'\r\n'+(line+'\r\n')*rows).encode()
print('plain MB %.0f' % (len(blob)/1e6), 'comp MB %.1f' % (len(zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=3).compress(blob))/1e6))
comp=zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=3).compress(blob)
job = {"version":3,"seed":"s","leases":[{"id":"L","prefix":"2001:db8:1:100::/56","start":0,"end":10,"subnets":[0],"low_count":2}],
       "services":[{"id":"S","kind":"adb"}],"queries":[10],
       "captures":[{"encoding":"zstd","chunks":[base64.b64encode(comp).decode()]}],
       "requests":[],"offers":[],"request_quotas":[],"offer_quotas":[]}
raw=json.dumps(job).encode()
print('input MB %.1f'%(len(raw)/1e6))
def lim():
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(2*1024**3,2*1024**3))
t=time.time()
done=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],input=raw,
                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE, preexec_fn=lim)
print('result', done.stdout[:60], 'rc', done.returncode, '%.1fs'%(time.time()-t), done.stderr[-200:])
print('child peak MB %.0f' % (resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024))
